authorization: User explicitly requested completion of independent confirmation, UniWM single-factor controls, and related-work positioning.

confirmation.selection_rule: first six finite navmesh random points separated by >=1.25m Euclidean, at most20000 attempts; yaw seeded uniform; no image/model-result filtering or replacement
confirmation.camera: same 640x480 HFOV90, level camera1.5m above navmesh, preserve K/depth/C2W
confirmation.history: four repeated current views; UniWM start=goal=current before native current sanitization
confirmation.checkpoint_selection: fixed before new renders; no training or checkpoint/hyperparameter selection using new set
confirmation.calibration: reuse original frozen RAFT geometry, known-shift, texture-mask, coverage and separation criteria; failed positions retained unknown, no replacement
confirmation.aggregation: report both scenes separately and equal-scene macro mean; all positions and seeds retained; no frame/seed-independent significance claims or population CI with only2 scenes
confirmation.scope: new to this study and Habitat adaptation; not claimed absent from published pretraining; zero-shot transfer to2 new scanned scenes, not proof of universal failure

mechanism.cohort: original2 development positions only; exploratory, not independent confirmation
mechanism.native42: 42 exact native replays included in252 generations; each must byte-match completed symmetric prediction, otherwise stop and retain failure
mechanism.design: goal arms only change goal; sampling arms form2x2 factorial with fixed goal,temperature,checkpoint,prompt,seed
mechanism.copy_diagnostic: actual post-VQ start/goal/current image code matches against generated784 codes; report separately from pixel equality
mechanism.teacher_forcing: optional analysis of collected native logits only; no new training or hidden parameter changes
mechanism.claim_limits: goal intervention changes training-context support; changed texture/noise alone is not improved action fidelity; no claim of unique training root cause

analysis.primary: paired-zero-corrected flow effect EPE on reference-only mask; full correct/reverse/nearzero/unknown denominator
secondary: input copying in pixels and tokens
analysis.units: 256x256 pixel motion; not physical degree error

scheduling: [redacted] Operational settings for sharing the inference GPU with unrelated services (job priority, pausing and resumption). Not part of the scientific protocol.
